column1: # M3GraphicsAtomsPerf v2 (-Xmx512m -XX:-TieredCompilation -Xbatch -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:CompileCommand=blackhole,M3GraphicsAtomsPerfSupport::consume), M3 = jdk.m3.graphics classes on the class path, oracle = Skija jars in their own class loader
# per row: warm-up (>= 12 calls and 40 ms per side), calibration on the compiled loops to 2 ms rounds, 11 rounds alternating the first side; ns/op = median round; no re-measuring
# ratio = ns/op M3 / ns/op oracle (above 1: M3 slower); spread = IQR of the 11 round ratios / their median; code SAME = same bytecode on both sides (member and module callees, modulo the rename)

# v3 gate: SAME rows are the run's noise (verdict NOISE, never failing); a DIFF row is an OUTLIER only above max(slack 1.5, largest SAME ratio of the run), OK_NOISE_BAND between the slack and that ceiling
